snippet.title: Raccoon Cocoon: A Cozy Puzzle Game - Trailer
snippet.description:
🌙 **Raccoon Cocoon** – A cozy puzzle experience awaits! 🦝✨

Join our mischievous yet adorable raccoon and bring order to beautiful little messes.
Place objects, align details, and find calm in the small things.

🧩 Relaxing atmosphere
🎵 Lo-fi soundtrack
🌸 Pixel art puzzles

📅 **Releasing on November 5!**

Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3666490/Raccoon_Cocoon_A_Cozy_Puzzle_Game/

#cozygame #raccooncocoon #indiegame
